patterns.note: An asymmetrical, masonry-style grid layout for project images, where images vary in size and aspect ratio, creating a dynamic visual flow.

A dramatic contrast in typography, featuring an extremely large, bold, wide sans-serif for the initial hero title, juxtaposed with very small, light sans-serif text for navigation and project details.
A minimalist base palette of stark white and black, allowing the vibrant and diverse color palettes within the project images to take center stage.
Upon scrolling, the initial oversized hero title dramatically shrinks and transitions into a compact, sticky navigation bar at the top left, revealing additional navigation links.
The site is structured as a continuous, scrollable gallery of project images, with minimal distinct 'sections' beyond the initial hero and the project grid.

technique_notes: The primary title element starts as a large, centered block. As the user scrolls down, this element animates to a much smaller size, repositions to the top-left corner, and integrates with additional navigation links to form a sticky header that remains visible throughout the scroll.
Project images are displayed in a responsive, fluid grid that adjusts to fill the available width, with images appearing to load or reveal as they enter the viewport during scrolling.

design_tokens.type_scale: An extremely oversized, bold, and wide sans-serif hero title (~8x body text) creates a strong initial impact, contrasted with very small, light sans-serif text for navigation and project descriptions.
design_tokens.radius: sharp — all images and containers feature crisp, 90-degree corners.
design_tokens.spacing: airy — generous whitespace surrounds the initial hero title, transitioning to a balanced, slightly dense grid for the project gallery.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its dynamic header transformation, where an initially massive, centered title dramatically shrinks and repositions to become a minimalist sticky navigation bar. This, combined with the editorial, gallery-like presentation of projects, creates a sophisticated and focused portfolio experience.
